name: over
js: __bw.world.tesla.set(4); const P=[]; __bw.scene.traverse(o=>{ if(o.name==='tesla'&&o.visible){ const p=new __bw.THREE.Vector3(); o.getWorldPosition(p); P.push(p);} }); window.__P=P; const c=__bw.ctl; c.minD=20; c.maxD=900; c.maxR=9999; c.camR=9999; let cx=0,cz=0; for(const p of P){cx+=p.x;cz+=p.z;} c.target.set(cx/4,10,cz/4); c.dist=330; c.polar=0.30; c.azim=0.0; return P.length;
